positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a multi-device simulation platform hooked up to a web ui. Integrated a client-server connection between two different containers, running their own systemd services to emulate our multi-device robot platform.

- Maintain our simulator platform to support current and new robot platforms to allow increased velocity in development of new features and bug fixing despite hardware limitations.

- Headed the effort in parallelizing Over The Air updates of our multi-device platform. Used Golang/Bash to manage delta or full image updates on device partitions from the cloud, used gRPC calls to ensure version compatibility between devices, and Grub to manage bootloading.

- Developed a new telemetry solution for our robots that would efficiently record all the data necessary(sensor data, events/commands, firmware) that allows us to deterministically replay the navigation, perception, localization, and mapping stacks. Data was managed in C++ and implemented the API in Python.

- Utilized our hardware abstraction layer to gather data from the sensors and propagate them throughout our various software stacks and also serialized/compressed it using Cap’n proto before sending it to the telemetry server where it was written to disk and then into the cloud(Google Cloud Storage and Amazon Web Services)

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Part of the FOTA(Firmware Over The Air) software team, developing software to allow the ECU(electronic control unit) firmware in the vehicle to be updated via the cloud.  
- Upgraded the Vehicle Update Manager to be able to process the newest version of the update package files that were based on Google Protocol Buffers. Wrote utilities to de-serialize update package files and display its contents. 
- Developed in Ubuntu using C++11 and Python on CodeLite and Pycharm IDEs.
- Used JIRA to manage software development tasks and Git/BitBucket for source code management using a Git Feature Branch workflow.
